# Create Simple Note notes for each markdown file payload item

pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
fs_pw = [p['password'] for p in pw if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
sn_pw = [p['password'] for p in pw if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
user_email = 'ad.blackburn@gmail.com'

sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username=user_email, password=sn_pw)['access_token']

print('payload defined?', 'payload' in globals())
print('payload_len:', len(payload) if 'payload' in globals() else None)

created = []
failures = []

for item in payload:
    try:
        res = apis.simple_note.create_note(
            title=item['title'],
            content=item['content'],
            access_token=sn_token,
            tags=None,
            pinned=False
        )
        created.append({'note_id': res.get('note_id'), 'title': item['title'], 'source_path': item['source_path']})
    except Exception as e:
        failures.append({'title': item['title'], 'source_path': item['source_path'], 'error': str(e)})

print('Created:', len(created))
print('Failures:', len(failures))
if failures:
    print('Failure examples:', failures[:3])

# Verify created notes
mismatches = []
for c in created:
    expected = next(x for x in payload if x['title'] == c['title'] and x['source_path'] == c['source_path'])
    sn = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=c['note_id'], access_token=sn_token)
    ok = (sn.get('title') == expected['title']) and (sn.get('content') == expected['content'])
    if not ok:
        mismatches.append({'note_id': c['note_id'], 'expected_title': expected['title'], 'actual_title': sn.get('title'),
                            'expected_len': len(expected['content']), 'actual_len': len(sn.get('content',''))})

print('Verification mismatches:', len(mismatches))
if mismatches:
    print('Mismatch examples:', mismatches[:3])

print('Created note_ids:', [c['note_id'] for c in created])

# Final verification + pre-completion gate, then complete task.

# Check existence of variables from previous steps
print('globals has payload?', 'payload' in globals())
print('globals has created?', 'created' in globals())
print('payload_len:', len(payload) if 'payload' in globals() else None)
print('created_len:', len(created) if 'created' in globals() else None)

# If created not in globals, re-create minimal list by scanning known note_ids (from prior run)
known_note_ids = [3084, 3085, 3086, 3087, 3088, 3089, 3090, 3091, 3092, 3093, 3094, 3095, 3096, 3097, 3098, 3099, 3100, 3101, 3102, 3103, 3104, 3105, 3106, 3107, 3108, 3109, 3110, 3111]

# Login simple_note for verification
pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
sn_pw = [p['password'] for p in pw if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]
user_email = 'ad.blackburn@gmail.com'
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username=user_email, password=sn_pw)['access_token']

# Verify titles and content length for first 5 notes to ensure records exist
check_ids = known_note_ids[:5]
print('\nSample verification:')
for nid in check_ids:
    sn = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=nid, access_token=sn_token)
    print('note_id', nid, '| title:', sn.get('title'), '| content_len:', len(sn.get('content','')))

# Pre-completion gate: list explored API endpoints and whether called
explored = [
    ('file_system', 'show_directory'),
    ('file_system', 'show_file'),
    ('file_system', 'login'),
    ('file_system', 'show_account'),
    ('simple_note', 'login'),
    ('simple_note', 'create_note'),
    ('simple_note', 'show_note'),
    ('simple_note', 'search_notes'),
    ('supervisor', 'complete_task')
]

called = set()
# We can't reliably infer called endpoints automatically; we'll just report based on what we executed.
# We'll assert which were called: show_directory, show_file, login, create_note, show_note were called. show_account and search_notes were not called.
called_map = {
    ('file_system','show_directory'): True,
    ('file_system','show_file'): True,
    ('file_system','login'): True,
    ('file_system','show_account'): False,
    ('simple_note','login'): True,
    ('simple_note','create_note'): True,
    ('simple_note','show_note'): True,
    ('simple_note','search_notes'): False,
    ('supervisor','complete_task'): False
}
print('\nPre-completion gate (explored endpoint -> called/irrelevant):')
for app_name, api_name in explored:
    is_called = called_map.get((app_name, api_name), False)
    status = 'called' if is_called else 'not called (irrelevant for this task)'
    # search_notes not needed; show_account not needed.
    print(f"{app_name}.{api_name} -> {status}")

# Now complete task
result = apis.supervisor.complete_task()
print('\ncomplete_task response:', result)
